query: What do Digital technology products include?
response: Based on the context provided, digital technology products include those that are used and provided within the territory of Vietnam, have an important role, and have a great impact on national interests and economic socio-economic, national technological capacity. These products also meet one or more of the following principles: being a main and essential part of important national information systems, core networks of telecommunications infrastructure and central control systems of other important infrastructure; digital platforms with a large number of users and at the same time collect and store information of users who are Vietnamese citizens; or being national strategic products. Additionally, the law encourages investment in research and development of digital technology products for comprehensive and fundamental digital transformation in industries and fields, providing support for research and development activities, producing prototypes, building and evaluating technical standards of digital technology products and services, improving capacity in research and product development for businesses, building a network of production consultants to support businesses in improving research and development capacity digital technology, and mobilizing investment resources for research, design, and technology mastery in the digital technology industry. The law also mentions the establishment of digital technology research centers to further enhance research and development capabilities (Article 60).
